name_zh: 阿连德/智利/社会主义/选举/政变/自杀/萨尔瓦多/拉莫内达
description_zh: 萨尔瓦多·阿连德 (1908-1973) 智利总统 (1970-1973) 社会党领导人，推行民主社会主义，被军事政变推翻，死于政变，体现了一种理想主义者的悲剧命运，代表了拉美左翼政治的终结。
description_en: Salvador Allende (1908-1973) Chilean President (1970-1973) Socialist Party leader, implemented democratic socialism, overthrown by military coup, died in the coup, represents a tragic fate of an idealist, embodies end of Latin American left-wing politics.
reason_zh: 阿连德代表了拉美如何尝试通过民主选举实现社会主义，但如何军事政变和外部干预导致理想破灭，以及拉美左翼政治的悲剧命运。
reason_en: Allende represents how Latin American tries to achieve socialism through democratic election, but military coup and foreign intervention cause ideal collapse, embodies tragedy of Latin American left-wing politics.
